02 / A CONVERSATION BETWEEN BITS

Many small checks. One clearer picture.

Follow a message through the decoder.

01
01010+ noise

Receive a noisy signal.

Bits arrive as uncertain measurements. A log-likelihood ratio says which bit is more likely, and by how much.

Lch = 2y / σ²
02
x₁cx₂

Let the checks weigh in.

Each check combines its other neighbors’ beliefs. It sends an extrinsic message: what those neighbors imply about this bit.

Hx = 0 (mod 2)
03
✓

Update. Repeat. Recover.

Combine check messages with the channel evidence. Repeat until every check passes, or the iteration budget runs out.

Lpost = Lch + Σ Lcheck
A positive LLR favors 0. A negative LLR favors 1. A value near zero means the decoder is unsure.
03 / FROM THE CLASSROOM TO THE CHANNEL

Your syllabus,
with a longer reach.

Hamming codes introduce the idea. LDPC codes scale it through sparse connections and soft decisions.

Download seminar deck PPTX · 16 slides
01 What makes it “low density”?

Most entries of H are zero. In this lab, every variable touches three checks and every check touches six variables. The density is 3/m; larger blocks stay locally connected.

02 How does it extend Hamming codes?

Both define linear block codes using Hx = 0. Hamming (7,4) guarantees correction of one bit error with hard-decision syndrome decoding. LDPC decoders use soft evidence and repeated local updates; there is no blanket guarantee of correcting a fixed number of errors.

03 How close to Shannon’s limit?

Well-designed, long LDPC codes can operate near capacity. This tiny, randomly constructed teaching code cannot establish that claim. The capacity tab shows the BPSK-constrained AWGN threshold separately from finite-length measurements.

04 Where do these codes live?

5G NR uses LDPC for data channels (polar codes serve control channels). DVB-S2 uses LDPC with an outer BCH code. Modern Wi-Fi standards support LDPC, and storage systems use LDPC to combat read errors.

THE FINE PRINT, WITHOUT THE FINE PRINT.

BPSK · AWGN · regular (3,6) graph · actual GF(2) rank · flooding schedule · sum-product or normalized min-sum.
Small blocks contain cycles. A valid codeword can still be the wrong codeword. No curve is a standard’s published performance.
